run_benchmarks: run gRPC microbenchmarks with configurable loops, jobs, and regex filters via bm_run.py
create_jobs: create a shuffled list of benchmark job specs for opt and counters configurations
collect_bm_data: collect benchmark test data by listing available tests and building job commands
parse_args: parse command line arguments for benchmark name, loops, jobs, and regex filter
run_opt_and_counters: run both opt and counters benchmark variants across multiple loops for noise reduction
